lines.t: I've been a long, dusty road I've been riding
Chasing dreams that always fade with the dawn
But in the stillness, I heard you calling
A whisper of mercy saying, child, come home
The world had my heart, but you bought it back
With a love no shadow can undo
Yahushua, you're the fire in my soul
The anchor that steadies when the wild winds blow
You found me a lost, now I'm made brand new
Forever I'm riding home to you
Your truth like rain on a thirsty field
Your word cuts deep, but it's how I heal
In your light all my fears get away
And joy like sunrise fills my days
You took my shame and turned it into a song
Now every breath sings where I belong
Yeah, who's sure you're the fire in my soul?
The anchor that steadies when the wild winds blow
You found me lost, now I'm made brand new
Forever I'm riding home to you
No silver, no gold can match your grace
You're my savior, my heart's resting place
When there's a light phase and the skies turn blue
I'll see the gates
And run to you
Yeshua, you're the fire in my soul
The anchor that steadies when the wild winds blow
You found me lost
Now I'm made brand new
Forever I'm riding home to you
Forever I'm riding home to you
Yeah, forever I'm riding home to you
We'll be right back.
